# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is described as round-faced, perpetually smiling, and good-natured.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy and quiet, often relying on others to speak on his behalf. Despite his shyness, he is a great worker, dependable, good-natured, and has no bad habits.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Goals

- To marry and establish a home on the upper farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. After his father deeded him the upper farm in his own name, he sought to get married. Long infatuated with Anne Shirley, his extreme shyness prevented him from courting her directly, so he persuaded his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf during the Christmas holidays. Upon being rejected by Anne, he quickly moved on and married Nettie Blewett. The couple made their public appearance at the Avonlea church on the Sunday following Anne's return from Redmond College, with Billy beaming with pride.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P17](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0017), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
